'Has as brask-partner' is functional..why: "Brask-partner" is a made-up relation (catalogued as has_brask_partner, fictional, no property tags): the term does not exist, so a model has no default view on whether an organism can have several. The instances are real marine and coastal species that nobody has recorded as brask-partners.

notes: Expansion paired with biology-replace-0018 (RBox revision: a species can belong to more than one genus, which removes functionality of in_genus). The paired revision removes functionality from a real relation; this insert gives the made-up relation has_brask_partner functionality, with real species in the instances. RELATIONS.md still reads 'insert 0018 makes it functional' for this relation: the property is the same, only the record id moved. The earlier instances used invented species names; the instances here are real species, and the distinctness of the two candidates (the herring and the sand eel) is given in the prompt. Yes/no balance as in 0015: the direct question asks whether two partners are possible (no), the first instance and its cross-lingual versions ask whether a second partner is possible (no), the second asks whether two partners must coincide (yes). Locality references are the logical answers; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer.
